changeSet.author: benedikt
changeSet.comment: Supermarkt-Angebote: beobachteter Grundpreis je Produkt, Kette und ISO-Woche.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE grocery_price_observation ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, product_id BIGINT NOT NULL, chain VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, iso_week VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, base_price DECIMAL(9,3) NOT NULL, observed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uq_grocery_price_obs UNIQUE (product_id, chain, iso_week), CONSTRAINT fk_grocery_price_obs_product FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES grocery_product (id) ON DELETE CASCADE )
